description.value: The Loden is a 77-room boutique hotel in Vancouver's Coal Harbour neighbourhood, holding a MICHELIN Key Award in 2024 and 2025 and ranked #1 hotel in Vancouver on TripAdvisor since 2020. It offers personalized service and high-end amenities steps from the downtown waterfront and Stanley Park cycling routes. The adjoining Tableau Bar Bistro is a French restaurant open for breakfast through dinner and in-room dining.
